meta.note: Paper mode: one layer-shared index per layer over the concatenated RoPE-free dims of every KV head, projected onto the layer's top-d_idx principal directions (centred), then L2 normalised. mass_outside_headavg is the paper target: A_i = mean over query heads of softmax over R_i = [sink_size, pos - window_size], summed over selected keys in R_i. top_recall is the share of the top min(2048, |R_i|//2) A_i keys selected. efficiency = method / exhaustive control at the same selection count.
